segments.sn6.8:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā divāvihāragato hoti paṭisallīno.
segments.sn6.8:1.3: Atha kho subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā suddhāvāso ca paccekabrahmā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā paccekaṃ dvārabāhaṃ nissāya aṭṭhaṃsu.
segments.sn6.8:1.4: Atha kho suddhāvāso paccekabrahmā katamodakatissakaṃ [katamorakatissakaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ.)] bhikkhuṃ ārabbha bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –

lines: Aṭṭhame akissavanti kissavā vuccati paññā, nippaññoti attho.
Kiṃ kusalagavesitāya “kiṃ kusalaṃ akusalan”tiādinā kinti suṇāti etāyāti kissa vā vuccati paññā.
